soal.soal: What is the correct greeting in the morning?
soal.pembahasan: Good morning untuk pagi hari. Good night malam sebelum tidur, good evening sore, good bye perpisahan.

soal.soal: My father's mother is my ...
soal.pembahasan: Ibunya ayah adalah nenek, grandmother. Mother ibu, sister saudara perempuan, aunt bibi.

soal.soal: Which one is a school object?
soal.pembahasan: Pencil adalah benda sekolah. Banana makanan, cat hewan, rain cuaca.

soal.soal: A cow says ...
soal.pembahasan: Sapi bersuara moo. Meow kucing, woof anjing, quack bebek.

soal.soal: I am hungry. I want to eat ...
soal.pembahasan: Lapar berarti ingin makan nasi, rice. Water dan juice minuman, soap sabun bukan makanan.

soal.soal: Today is very hot. The weather is ...
soal.pembahasan: Panas berarti sunny. Rainy hujan, snowy salju, windy berangin.

soal.soal: Every morning, Siti ... her teeth.
soal.pembahasan: Subjek Siti she, jadi brushes. Brush untuk I/you/they, brushing butuh to be, brushed lampau.

soal.soal: There ... two books on the table.
soal.pembahasan: Two books jamak, jadi are. Is untuk tunggal, am untuk I, was lampau tunggal.

soal.soal: The cat is ... the table. The cat is below the table.
soal.pembahasan: Below the table berarti under the table. On the table di atas, in the sky di langit, under water di bawah air, tidak sesuai keterangan below.

soal.soal: Choose the correct sentence: She ... to school by bus.
soal.pembahasan: She goes, karena she + verb + s. Go untuk I/you/they, going butuh to be, gone butuh have.

soal.soal: I ... apples. I eat them every day.
soal.pembahasan: Makan setiap hari berarti suka, like. Hates dan dislikes berlawanan, hate juga berlawanan.

soal.soal: Which adjective is correct? The elephant is ...
soal.pembahasan: Gajah itu big, besar. Tiny, small, little berarti kecil, berlawanan dengan gajah.

soal.soal: Look! The children ... in the yard now.
soal.pembahasan: Now menunjukkan present continuous, jadi are playing. Plays dan play simple present, played lampau.

soal.soal: What time is it? It is 7 o'clock in the morning. It is time to ...
soal.pembahasan: Pukul 7 pagi waktunya berangkat sekolah. Opsi lain untuk malam hari.

soal.soal: Twenty + five = ...
soal.pembahasan: 20 + 5 = 25, twenty-five. Fifteen 15, twenty 20, thirty-five 35.

soal.soal: Read: Rani has long hair. She has brown eyes. She is tall. Rani is ...

opsi.B: A tall girl with long hair and brown eyes

soal.pembahasan: Teks menyebut Rani rambut panjang, mata cokelat, tinggi. Opsi B sesuai semua ciri, opsi lain mengubah ciri.

soal.soal: Which sentence is NOT correct?
soal.pembahasan: He are salah, seharusnya he is. Opsi lain pasangan subjek dan to be sudah benar.

soal.soal: Budi: What is your hobby? Andi: I like ...
soal.pembahasan: Tanya hobi dijawab playing football. Opsi lain umur, nama, tempat tinggal bukan hobi.

soal.soal: Today is Monday. Tomorrow is ...
soal.pembahasan: Setelah Senin adalah Selasa, Tuesday. Sunday sebelum Senin, Friday dan Saturday jauh.

soal.soal: Which is the correct order? (1) Wash your hands (2) Eat lunch (3) Pray before eating
soal.pembahasan: Urutan yang benar cuci tangan, berdoa, lalu makan. Opsi lain membalik urutan kebersihan dan doa.

soal.soal: Two students say: X: All fruits are sweet. Y: Some fruits are sweet, some are sour. The taste depends on the fruit. Which is better?

opsi.A: X, because all fruits are always sweet
opsi.D: Y, because Y shows fruits have different tastes

soal.pembahasan: Y lebih baik karena buah punya rasa beda-beda. X terlalu mutlak dengan kata all dan always sweet.

soal.soal: Read the notice: Please keep the library quiet. What should students do?
soal.pembahasan: Keep quiet berarti berbicara pelan. Berteriak, berlari, bermain bola berlawanan dengan notice.

soal.soal: Which invitation is the most polite?

opsi.A: Would you like to come to my birthday party?

soal.pembahasan: Would you like paling sopan untuk mengundang. Come now dan you must memaksa, go away mengusir.

soal.soal: Make the best sentence to ask for help in class!

opsi.B: Excuse me, Miss, could you help me with this question, please?

soal.pembahasan: Meminta tolong paling tepat dengan excuse me, could you help me, please. Opsi lain bukan meminta tolong.

soal.soal: Make the best plan to keep the classroom clean!

opsi.B: Wait for the teacher to clean
opsi.D: Make a picket schedule + put rubbish in the bin + check the class every Friday

soal.pembahasan: Rencana terbaik ada jadwal piket, buang sampah ke tempatnya, dan cek tiap Jumat. Opsi lain mengotori, pasif, atau menutup kelas.
